title: My journey to yo-yo mastery | BLACK
speaker: BLACK

sentences.en: Transcriber: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast When I was 14 years old,
sentences.zh: 在我14 岁的时候，

sentences.en: I had low self-esteem. I felt I was not talented at anything.
sentences.zh: 我是个自卑的人，我觉得自己一无所长。

sentences.en: One day, I bought a yo-yo. When I tried my first trick, it looked like this: (Laughter)
sentences.zh: 有一天，我买了个溜溜球。当我第一次试着玩时， 它看起来是这个样子的，

sentences.en: I couldn't even do the simplest trick, but it was very natural for me, because I was not dextrous, and hated all sports.
sentences.zh: 我甚至无法使出简单的招数。然而，这对我来说很正常，因为我并不灵巧，而且厌恶所有运动。

sentences.en: But after one week of practicing, my throws became more like this: A bit better.
sentences.zh: 但经过一个星期的练习，我可以做出这样的动作了，稍微好了一些。

sentences.en: I thought, the yo-yo is something for me to be good at.
sentences.zh: 我认为，溜溜球将会是 我这辈子

sentences.en: For the first time in my life, I found my passion.
sentences.zh: 所擅长的第一样东西。我发现了我的热情。

sentences.en: I was spending all my time practicing. It took me hours and hours a day to build my skills up to the next level.
sentences.zh: 我把我所有的时间都用在练习上，每天好几个小时，来锻炼我的技能以达到更高水平。

sentences.en: And then, four years later, when I was 18 years old, I was standing onstage at the World YoYo Contest.
sentences.zh: 接着，四年后，当我年满 18 岁时，我站在世界溜溜球比赛的舞台上，

sentences.en: And I won. I was so excited. "Yes, I did it! I became a hero.
sentences.zh: 我赢了。我当时是如此兴奋。 “是的，我做到了！我成了英雄。

sentences.en: I may get many sponsors, a lot of money, tons of interviews, and be on TV!" I thought.
sentences.zh: 我将会有很多赞助商，会有很多钱，

sentences.en: (Laughter) But after coming back to Japan, totally nothing changed in my life.
sentences.zh: 一堆的访谈，也可以上电视了！” 我是这么想的。（笑声）但回到日本后，我的生活没有任何改变。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I realized society didn't value my passion.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，社会不重视我的热情。

sentences.en: So I went back to my college and became a typical Japanese worker as a systems engineer.
sentences.zh: 所以我回到大学，成为一个典型的日本劳动者，系统工程师。

sentences.en: I felt my passion, heart and soul, had left my body.
sentences.zh: 我感到我的热情、理想、和灵魂 已离开我的身体。

sentences.en: I felt I was not alive anymore. So I started to consider what I should do, and I thought, I wanted to make my performance better, and to show onstage how spectacular the yo-yo could be
sentences.zh: 我丧失了活着的感觉，所以，我开始考虑我应该做什么，我想我要使我的表演更好，并在舞台上展示 溜溜球表演可以多么壮观

sentences.en: to change the public's image of the yo-yo.
sentences.zh: 以改变大家对溜溜球的印象

sentences.en: So I quit my company and started a career as a professional performer.
sentences.zh: 所以我辞掉我的工作，并作为一个专业的表演人， 开始了我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I started to learn classic ballet, jazz dance, acrobatics and other things to make my performance better.
sentences.zh: 我开始学习古典芭蕾、 爵士舞、和杂技等等，以使我的表演更好。

sentences.en: As a result of these efforts, and the help of many others, it happened.
sentences.zh: 由于这些努力和其他许多人的帮助，奇迹出现了。

sentences.en: I won the World YoYo Contest again in the artistic performance division.
sentences.zh: 我再次在世界溜溜球大赛的表演艺术类别中赢得大奖。

sentences.en: I passed an audition for Cirque Du Soleil.
sentences.zh: 我通过了太阳马戏团（Cirque du Soleil）的试镜。

sentences.en: Today, I am standing on the TED stage with the yo-yo in front of you.
sentences.zh: 今天，我站在 TED 舞台上，带着溜溜球站在你们面前。

sentences.en: (Applause) What I learned from the yo-yo is, if I make enough effort with huge passion, there is no impossible.
sentences.zh: （掌声）我从溜溜球之中所学到的就是：只要心怀热情，不懈努力，就没有不可能的事。

sentences.en: Could you let me share my passion with you through my performance?
sentences.zh: 请允许我为你们演出，让我与你们分享我的热情。（掌声）（水声）（音乐）
